newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Prices fall at New Zealand wool sales.
newsitem.headline: Prices fall at New Zealand wool sales.

text.p: Wool prices fell at wool sales in Napier and Christchurch, Wools of New Zealand said.
The provisional segment indicators compared with last week's sales (in cents per kg clean) were:
There were 3,926 tonnes on offer of which 19 percent was passed in. Crossbred fleece comprised 43 percent of the offering and second shear 25 percent.

Merino fleece was 0-2 percent dearer, halbred fleece 0-2 percent cheaper, crossbred fleece 0-2.5 percent cheaper, cotts up to 1.5 percent cheaper, second shear up to 2 percent cheaper, first lambs generally 1 percent cheaper, second lambs 2 percent dearer, bulky skirtings up to 1 percent dearer and second shear bellies and pieces 2.5-5.0 percent dearer.
Principal interest came from Western Europe, China, Nepal, Turkey, Iran and India. The next sales are on January 9.
